archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-09.5 Ensure Performance, Security, and Continuity
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once platforms are operational, maintaining them becomes critical. This step ensures that the infrastructure remains secure, reliable, and high-performing.
Monitoring tools continuously track performance metrics such as response time, resource usage, and availability. Security teams watch for intrusions, vulnerabilities, or misconfigurations, applying updates and patches regularly. Disaster recovery procedures are tested to ensure data and operations can be restored quickly in case of failure. Service-level agreements (SLAs) are defined to maintain expected uptime and performance levels.
These activities protect the organization’s data assets and guarantee operational resilience, even in the face of incidents or cyber threats.
Value created: Secure, stable, and resilient platforms that ensure continuous statistical operations.
